clue.text: Second base rate reduction

parts.note: low-down means base or dishonourable, as in a low-down trick

explanation.surface: A banking report: a second cut to the base rate of interest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'base rate' reads as the Bank of England's interest rate, but 'base' is the word for LOWDOWN.
explanation.definitionFit: A slackening of pace or activity is a reduction in its rate.

clue.text: Spooner's choice for one's remuneration during disorder

indicators.note: the Reverend Spooner swapped the opening sounds of words, so the first letters of the two pieces change places

parts.note: a pick is a choice, as in take your pick
say means for one, for example

explanation.surface: Someone picks how their pay should be made during a time of unrest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'choice for one' reads as a single phrase, but it splits into two pieces whose opening letters trade places.
explanation.definitionFit: Wages paid while an employee is off ill, illness being a disorder of the body.

clue.text: Show too much faith in patent on corrosion

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: patent means obvious or open, the same as overt
rust is the corrosion of iron

explanation.surface: Someone places too much faith in a patent for a rust treatment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'patent' looks like a noun, an inventor's right, but here it is the adjective meaning obvious.
explanation.definitionFit: To trust excessively is to place too much faith in someone or something.

clue.text: The German on dating app briefly is stylish and attractive

parts.note: das is a German word for the

indicators.note: briefly means the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: Hinge is a well-known dating app

explanation.surface: A German on a dating app is described as smart and good-looking.
explanation.definitionFit: Dashing describes someone smartly dressed and attractive in a lively way.

clue.text: Hair in drink, not unknown, right?

indicators.note: not says the unknown is left out of the drink

parts.note: whiskey is a drink, the Irish and American spelling of whisky
Y is an algebraic unknown, as are X and Z

explanation.surface: A diner finds a hair in their drink and asks if that is acceptable.
explanation.definitionFit: A whisker is a single hair, especially one on the face.

clue.text: Cover article involved in reproduction

indicators.note: involved in means the article sits within the other word

parts.note: a copy is a reproduction
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A news piece on biology covers an article about reproduction.
explanation.definitionFit: A canopy is an overhead covering, such as an awning or tree crown.

clue.text: President's win following smart cut

indicators.note: following means the win word is placed after the cut-down smart word
cut says the word loses its last letter

parts.note: clever means smart
to land a prize is to win it

explanation.surface: A president scores a victory after a clever budget cut.
explanation.walkthrough: Grover Cleveland was a US president; 's here is the link 'has'.
explanation.definitionFit: Grover Cleveland served twice as US president, the 22nd and 24th holder of the office.

clue.text: Husband interrupts sleep with position where risk is worth taking

definitions.text: position where risk is worth taking

parts.note: a nap is a short sleep
and means with, together with

explanation.surface: A husband disturbs someone's sleep, which may be worth the risk.
explanation.walkthrough: In the card game nap, a nap hand is one good enough to bid all five tricks; the phrase means a chance worth taking.
explanation.definitionFit: Figuratively a situation so promising that taking a gamble on it is justified.

clue.text: Philip exposed compiler as sucker for science

parts.note: Pip is a short form of the name Philip

indicators.note: exposed means stripped of its outer letters

parts.note: a setter compiles a crossword

explanation.surface: Philip unmasks the puzzle-compiler as a fan of science.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sucker' sounds like a dupe, but it is something that sucks up liquid.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipette is a laboratory tube that draws up liquid by suction.

clue.text: Perhaps Queen's musical composition

parts.note: Chess is a stage musical by Tim Rice and the men of ABBA
a piece is a musical composition

explanation.surface: The rock band Queen's music, seen as a composition.
explanation.walkthrough: Queen reads as the rock band; it is the chessboard's most powerful piece.
explanation.definitionFit: The queen is one example of a playing piece in chess, hence the Perhaps.

clue.text: The most important Catholic is Father Ted, essentially

parts.note: pop is an informal word for father

indicators.note: essentially points to the central letter of the word

explanation.surface: Father Ted, the TV priest, is the leading Catholic at heart.
explanation.walkthrough: Father Ted is a sitcom about Irish priests, which misleads toward a clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pope heads the Roman Catholic Church, so ranks highest among Catholics.

clue.text: Actor's wife trips attacker up

indicators.note: up means stirred up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: An actor's wife trips up an assailant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' looks like part of the phrase trips up, but it signals that W, TRIPS and ATTACKER are shuffled.
explanation.definitionFit: Patrick Stewart is an English actor, known for Star Trek and Shakespeare.

clue.text: Less experienced guy, one upset by Blackadder's ending

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so these letters are rearranged
ending points to the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: A green young man, one who was upset by how Blackadder ended.
explanation.walkthrough: Blackadder is a British TV comedy whose final episode ends in tragedy.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone younger has typically had less time to gain experience.

clue.text: Period of celebration once politician in Ireland departs, indeed

indicators.note: in places the politician inside the name for Ireland

parts.note: Eire is the Irish name for Ireland
MP is a Member of Parliament
D is the abbreviation for departs on timetables
ay is an old word for yes, indeed

explanation.surface: A celebration starts once an Irish politician leaves.
explanation.walkthrough: Empire Day, 24 May, was celebrated across the British Empire until renamed in 1958.
explanation.definitionFit: A former annual holiday marking the British Empire, so a past day of festivities.

clue.text: Wanting it more organised, rearranged ride

parts.note: to run an event is to organise it

indicators.note: rearranged signals the next word's letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Someone who organised a ride and then rearranged it wants it more.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of randy, lustful, so wanting sex more keenly.

clue.text: Press corps, powerless after reforming, beginning to seek medal

parts.note: to iron clothes is to press them

indicators.note: reforming means rearranging the letters; after puts them after the press word
powerless means the letter for power is removed
beginning to points to the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Press corps lose their power after reforms and start seeking a medal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Iron Cross is a German military decoration for bravery.

clue.text: Muse, content to neuter pets

indicators.note: the content of the phrase is letters held inside it

explanation.surface: A muse is happy to have her pets spayed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'content' looks like an adjective meaning happy, but it means what the words contain.
explanation.definitionFit: Euterpe is the Greek Muse of music and lyric poetry.

clue.text: Country drops back to serve another

parts.note: UK is the United Kingdom
rain comes in drops

indicators.note: back to points to the last letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A country pulls out of a tournament and returns another to serve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Country' looks like the definition, but it gives UK; the answer is defined by 'another', meaning another country.
explanation.definitionFit: Ukraine is a further country beyond the one named first in the clue.

clue.text: Each short rest is most relaxed

indicators.note: short means the last letter is removed

parts.note: a siesta is an afternoon rest

explanation.surface: Each brief rest is the most relaxing.
explanation.definitionFit: Easy can mean relaxed or comfortable, and the superlative is the most so.

clue.text: American study papers over cracks regarding biological tissue

indicators.note: cracks means the over letter breaks into the others

parts.note: a den is a study or private room
ID stands for identity papers
O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: A US study papers over the cracks in some biological research.
explanation.walkthrough: 'papers over cracks' reads as an idiom, but each word gives letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Adenoid as an adjective means relating to gland-like or lymphoid tissue.

clue.text: Voracious eater with big nose, Anthea Turner finally making husband billions

indicators.note: the husband letter is swapped for the letter for billions
finally points to the last letter of the name

explanation.surface: TV presenter Anthea Turner finally makes her husband a billionaire.
explanation.walkthrough: Anthea Turner is a British TV presenter. ANTHEA plus R gives ANTHEAR; H (husband) becomes B (billions).
explanation.definitionFit: The antbear, or aardvark, has a long snout and devours ants and termites.

clue.text: Protein in fool's beer rising

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means read from the bottom up

parts.note: a nit is a fool; with the possessive s
ale is a beer

explanation.surface: A protein found in an idiot's beer rises to the top.
explanation.definitionFit: Elastin is an elastic protein in skin and connective tissue.

clue.text: Think about fellow eating handsomely

indicators.note: eating means the fellow word surrounds the other

parts.note: a don is a fellow of a university college
well means handsomely, as in paid well

explanation.surface: Reflect on a man who eats well.
explanation.definitionFit: To dwell on something is to keep thinking about it.

clue.text: Funds kept back from park and large farm in outskirts of Tallahassee

parts.note: a reserve is a protected park for wildlife

indicators.note: in places the farm inside the outer letters
outskirts means the first and last letters of the city name

parts.note: a ranch is a large farm

explanation.surface: Money saved from a park and a big farm on the edge of Tallahassee.
explanation.definitionFit: A reserve tranche is the part of a nation's IMF quota held back for emergencies.

clue.text: Heartless French girl's put on record

indicators.note: heartless means a central letter is removed

parts.note: fille is French for girl

explanation.surface: A cold-hearted French girl is written into the records.
explanation.definitionFit: To file a document is to put it on record officially.

clue.text: Leaves fuel in arid ground

parts.note: to leave someone is to desert them
oil is a fuel

explanation.surface: Fuel leaks into dry soil.
explanation.definitionFit: Desert soil is the dry earth found in deserts.

clue.text: Extremely arresting stone church's storage room

indicators.note: arresting means holding, so one word captures the other

parts.note: very means extremely
ST is the abbreviation for stone, the weight

explanation.surface: A striking stone church has an extremely good store room.
explanation.definitionFit: A vestry is a room in a church where vestments and items are kept.

clue.text: Introduces tolls to get rid of borders

indicators.note: borders means the bin word goes round the outside

parts.note: to bin something is to throw it away
a bell tolls when it rings

explanation.surface: A government brings in tolls, then scraps them at the borders.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring in a law or practice is to introduce it.
